text_en: Wisdom protected the first-formed father of the world, when he alone had been created; she delivered him from his transgression,
text_cn: 智慧保护了最初受造，世界上唯一的原祖，

text_en: and gave him strength to rule all things.
text_cn: 救他脱离了本身的罪过，给了他统治万物的能力。

text_en: But when an unrighteous man departed from her in his anger, he perished because in rage he killed his brother.
text_cn: 但当不义者在愤怒中背弃了智慧，遂怒杀兄弟而自取灭亡。

text_en: When the earth was flooded because of him, wisdom again saved it, steering the righteous man by a paltry piece of wood.
text_cn: 因他的缘故，洪水淹没了世界，仍是智慧指引义人，藉着贱价的木材，拯救了世界。

text_en: Wisdom also, when the nations in wicked agreement had been put to confusion, recognized the righteous man and preserved him blameless before God, and kept him strong in the face of his compassion for his child.
text_cn: 当列国同谋作恶而混乱时， 智慧又辨别出义人来，加以保护，使他在天主前无瑕可指；当他痛惜儿子时，又坚强了他。

text_en: Wisdom rescued a righteous man when the ungodly were perishing; he escaped the fire that descended on the Five Cities.
text_cn: 当不虔敬的人被毁灭时，智慧救了义人， 逃脱了那降在五城的天火；

text_en: Evidence of their wickedness still remains: a continually smoking wasteland, plants bearing fruit that does not ripen, and a pillar of salt standing as a monument to an unbelieving soul.
text_cn: 为证明他们的邪恶，这块荒地还在冒烟；树木结果，却不成熟；盐柱留在那里，以作那无信的灵魂的纪念碑。

text_en: For because they passed wisdom by, they not only were hindered from recognizing the good, but also left for humankind a reminder of their folly, so that their failures could never go unnoticed.
text_cn: 因为他们离弃了智慧，不但害得自己不认识善事，而且还给世人留下了他们愚妄的纪念，致使他们的过犯一点也不能隐瞒。

text_en: Wisdom rescued from troubles those who served her.
text_cn: 但是，智慧却从困难中拯救了崇拜她的人。

text_en: When a righteous man fled from his brother’s wrath, she guided him on straight paths; she showed him the kingdom of God, and gave him knowledge of holy things; she prospered him in his labors, and increased the fruit of his toil.
text_cn: 智慧引导逃避长兄愤怒的义人，走上了正路；将天主的国指示给他，叫他明白神圣的事；在困苦之中使他顺利，令他的勤劳效果丰满。

text_en: When his oppressors were covetous, she stood by him and made him rich.
text_cn: 有人由于贪婪，窘迫他时，智慧又在旁协助，使他致富。

text_en: She protected him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those who lay in wait for him; in his arduous contest she gave him the victory, so that he might learn that godliness is more powerful than anything else.
text_cn: 智慧保护他脱离仇敌，使他安全，不受暗算；在他搏斗时，使他获胜，叫他明了虔敬的能力，高于一切。

text_en: When a righteous man was sold, wisdom did not desert him, but delivered him from sin. She descended with him into the dungeon,
text_cn: 智慧没有离弃被卖的义人，反而救他免于罪恶；

text_en: and when he was in prison she did not leave him, until she brought him the scepter of a kingdom and authority over his masters. Those who accused him she showed to be false, and she gave him everlasting honor.
text_cn: 与他同入坑狱，在缧绁（léi xiè）之中，也没有舍弃他，直到令他取得王权，统治欺压他的人们，证明诬谤他的人说的尽是谎言；赏给了他永垂不朽的光荣。

text_en: A holy people and blameless race wisdom delivered from a nation of oppressors.
text_cn: 智慧拯救了圣洁的民族，使无瑕可指的种族，脱离压迫他们的异民。

text_en: She entered the soul of a servant of the Lord, and withstood dread kings with wonders and signs.
text_cn: 她进入了上主仆人的灵魂，藉异能和奇迹，对抗可畏的君王。

text_en: She gave to holy people the reward of their labors; she guided them along a marvelous way, and became a shelter to them by day, and a starry flame through the night.
text_cn: 她酬报了圣徒的劳苦，领他们走上了奇妙的道路：日间作他们的荫凉，夜里作他们的星光；

text_en: She brought them over the Red Sea, and led them through deep waters;
text_cn: 领他们走过了红海，引他们穿过了洪涛，

text_en: but she drowned their enemies, and cast them up from the depth of the sea.
text_cn: 却淹没了他们的仇敌，又将他们从海底抛出；因此，义人反夺得了不虔敬者的战利品。

text_en: Therefore the righteous plundered the ungodly; they sang hymns, O Lord, to your holy name, and praised with one accord your defending hand;
text_cn: 上主！他们遂称颂了你的圣名，同心赞美了你施展卫护的手臂；

text_en: for wisdom opened the mouths of those who were mute, and made the tongues of infants speak clearly.
text_cn: 因为，智慧开了哑巴的口，使婴儿的舌伶俐善言。
